# Bizfluent

> > Business education resource providing practical guides on organizational management, accounting principles, and economic fundamentals.

Bizfluent offers comprehensive articles and tutorials covering business operations, financial reporting under GAAP, organizational structure, and market economics. The site serves entrepreneurs, small business owners, and students seeking actionable business knowledge.

## Key Topics

- GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)
- Organizational functions
- Business departments
- Company structure
- Front-office and back-office operations
- Employer associations
- Human resources management
- Financial statements
- Global industry
- International markets
- Business advocacy
- Nonprofit organizations
- Market equilibrium
- Supply and demand

## Organizational Structure & Management

- [What Are Organizational Functions?](https://bizfluent.com/info-8453523-organizational-functions.html): Explains core business functions: operations, marketing, HR, IT, finance
- [What Is Organization Structure?](https://bizfluent.com/facts-5030896-organization-structure.html): Explains organizational structure, reporting systems, and departments
- [The Role of Employer Associations](https://bizfluent.com/facts-6889831-role-employer-associations.html): Defines employer associations as nonprofit advocacy organizations

## Accounting & Financial Reporting

- [How to Record Unrealized Gains or Losses on Financial Statements](https://bizfluent.com/how-8315749-record-gains-losses-financial-statements.html): Guide to recording unrealized gains/losses per GAAP for small businesses

## Economics & Market Analysis

- [How to Calculate Equilibrium Output](https://bizfluent.com/how-8742398-calculate-equilibrium-output.html): Tutorial on calculating market equilibrium using supply-demand curves
- [Global Industry Definition](https://bizfluent.com/facts-6864353-global-industry-definition.html): Defines global industries operating across worldwide markets
